description: This file defines a FastAPI application for a resume screening backend API. It includes endpoints for health checks, uploading resumes, listing resumes, creating and listing criteria, ranking resumes against criteria, and listing ranked candidates. It also contains internal functions for processing data, scoring resumes based on criteria, and converting database rows to output models.

methods.name: _normalize_db_json
methods.description: Normalizes database JSON/JSONB values to Python dicts, handling different data types.

methods.name: _resume_row_to_out
methods.description: Converts a database resume row to a ResumeOut model.

methods.name: _criteria_row_to_out
methods.description: Converts a database criteria row to a CriteriaOut model.

methods.name: _ranking_row_to_out
methods.description: Converts a database ranking row to a RankingOut model.

methods.name: health_check
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple JSON payload indicating service health.

methods.name: upload_resume
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a resume file, extract text and structured fields, and store in database.

methods.name: list_resumes
methods.description: Endpoint to list uploaded resumes with metadata and extracted fields.

methods.name: create_criteria
methods.description: Endpoint to create new screening criteria stored as JSON.

methods.name: list_criteria
methods.description: Endpoint to list criteria ordered by creation date.

methods.name: _compute_score
methods.description: Calculates a score for a resume based on criteria JSON and extracted resume data.

methods.name: rank_all
methods.description: Ranks all resumes against a specified criteria set, stores results, and returns rankings.

methods.name: list_ranked_candidates
methods.description: Lists resumes ranked for a specific criteria ID, ordered by score.
